reason: Runs automated accessibility assertions in the Playwright application journey.
maintenance: The package is version-pinned and reviewed alongside Playwright and axe-core updates before its accessibility assertions change.
provenance: This is Deque's Playwright integration for axe-core, resolved to the exact Bun lockfile artifact and integrity above.
alternatives: Playwright alone has no accessibility rules engine; a local implementation would duplicate axe-core and provide weaker evidence.
